description: Register **additional lecturers** — a second instructor, assistant, or helper — on one or more classes, and control which of their sessions each one actually works. This is NOT how you set or change a class's main instructor (that is `classes_update`, or `sessions_update` for one-off substitutions); additional lecturers are extra people who work *alongside* the main instructor. By default a lecturer you add here works **every** session of the class — that is the normal arrangement. Restrict one to certain days by giving that assignment `weekdays` (1=Monday … 7=Sunday), or to hand-picked sessions with `event_ids`. This handles the whole "Martin works Mondays, Peter works Tuesdays, both on Wednesdays" pattern across a programme's classes in one action. Select classes with `schedule_ids`, or the way operators say it — `course_id` plus `billing_period_id` ("the Junior classes in Winter 2026"). Resolve `trainer_id` first with `classes_find_resource kind:"trainer"`, and the programme and billing period with `classes_find_courses` and `classes_find_resource kind:"billing_period"`. `role` is one of `secondary` ("Secondary instructor", the default), `assistant` ("Assistant"), `helper` ("Assistant instructor") or `trainer` ("Instructor"), and is per CLASS — Zooza cannot give someone one role on Mondays and another on Wednesdays. This writes across every class and session you select, so it is a two-step tool: call it once with no token to get a plan naming every class and session count, show that to the operator, then call it again with the returned token and `confirmed: true`. To SEE who is currently assigned, use `sessions_find_events` (per session) or `classes_find_classes` (the class roster).

assignments.description: Who to put on these classes. Entries for one trainer merge, so "Martin Mondays, Peter Tuesdays, both Wednesdays" is two entries: Martin [1,3], Peter [2,3].

event_ids.description: Restrict to these exact sessions instead of weekdays; must be in the selected classes.

from.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only sessions on or after this date.

role.description: Role on the class, default `secondary`. One role per person per class; cannot vary by session.

to.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only sessions on or before this date.

trainer_id.description: The lecturer to add. Resolve with classes_find_resource kind:"trainer".

weekdays.description: Restrict to these weekdays, 1=Mon … 7=Sun. OMIT for the normal case — no restriction means EVERY session of the class, and then `session_scope` is required.

billing_period_id.description: Term block narrowing the programme. classes_find_resource kind:"billing_period".

clear_unlisted.description: Default false: sessions in `existing_outside_rules` are left alone. True only once the operator confirms they meant "these days and nothing else".

company_id.description: Zooza company id to operate against. Optional: if the user has exactly one company, the server defaults to it — you can omit this field. With multiple companies, you MUST specify which; get the id list from `whoami.available_companies[].id`. If the user hasn't indicated which company they mean, ask them before guessing.

confirmed.description: Required (true) on the apply call, alongside `token`. Asserts that you have SHOWN the user the preview from the first call and they approved it — not that you believe the change is correct. If the user has not seen the preview, show it and ask before setting this. Must be omitted on the preview call.

course_id.description: Programme whose classes to act on. Requires billing_period_id. Resolve with classes_find_courses.

deactivate.description: Turn someone OFF on specific sessions, leaving them on the class roster.

event_ids.description: Switch them off on these exact sessions.

from.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only sessions on or after this date.

to.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only sessions on or before this date.

weekdays.description: Switch them off on these weekdays, 1=Mon … 7=Sun.

remove_from_class.description: Remove these lecturers from the selected classes ENTIRELY — roster row AND every session assignment. Not reversible in one step; the preview states the session count.

schedule_ids.description: Classes to act on, by id (resolve with classes_find_classes). Use this OR course_id.

session_scope.description: REQUIRED when an assignment has no weekdays/event_ids — that person lands on every session otherwise. `upcoming` (usual) / `all` (incl. past) / `class_only` (roster only). Ignored when restricted.

token.description: Omit on the FIRST call — that call previews the change and returns a token. Pass the token back on the SECOND call to apply the previewed change. Single-use, expires in 15 minutes; if it is expired or already used, run the preview again.

name: trainers_add_helpers
title: Add additional lecturers to classes and sessions
